linkedin.title: I started building a news app in my teens because the way we consume information felt broken.
linkedin.body:
The problem wasn't a lack of news. It was the noise. Every morning felt like drinking from a firehose of headlines, most of which had nothing to do with my actual interests or needs. I wanted a way to filter out the clutter without losing the context of what is happening in the world.

Building Headlinne meant asking a simple question. Can AI actually act like a thoughtful editor instead of just a content machine? We wanted to create a tool that learns what you care about and delivers it clearly. It is not about keeping you scrolling for hours. It is about giving you the essentials so you can get on with your day.

Technology is only as good as the problem it solves. For us, that means respecting your time and focusing on accuracy. We are still learning and building every single day, but the goal remains the same. We want to make sure you are informed, not overwhelmed.

instagram.caption:
House Republicans have officially blocked an attempt to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

The move comes after critics alleged he violated the constitution regarding his handling of the Iran war.

Hegseth had previously dismissed the impeachment effort as a stunt. By rejecting the motion, the House has effectively cleared the path for him to continue his role without this specific legislative hurdle.

This decision highlights the sharp divide in how Congress views the administration's military oversight. Does this vote signal the end of impeachment efforts against this administration for now?
